maddeler.e:
أنملخ (form VII)
# أَنْمَلِخُ (ʔanmaliḵu) /ʔan.ma.li.xu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# أَنْمَلِخَ (ʔanmaliḵa) /ʔan.ma.li.xa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
# أَنْمَلِخْ (ʔanmaliḵ) /ʔan.ma.lix/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْمَلَخَ (inmalaḵa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
